crossRefs.note: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.
All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel…
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
translations.bsb: Strike a mocker, and the simple will beware; rebuke the discerning man, and he will gain knowledge.
translations.kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
translations.asv: Smite a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; And reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
